approach.name: Gallery
approach.description: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

pages.label: Announcement bar
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Store promise bar
sections.intent: A bright, slim strip where the store's own messages take turns: an offer code, free delivery over a set amount, COD or easy returns. Short, warm lines any Indian store can fill in.
sections.layout: A slow edge-to-edge marquee of messages separated by small playful icons

pages.label: Header
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Top bar and menu
sections.intent: Logo and a wide, rounded search box share the first row, because a store selling anything, from sarees to spark plugs, is shopped by searching. The menu of top categories sits below with account and cart. On phones it shrinks to a compact bar with the menu tucked away.
sections.layout: Logo and a wide pill-shaped search on one row, icons at the right end, the menu row below

pages.label: Home
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Big welcome picture
sections.intent: The store's own campaign picture fills the screen with one bold, friendly line, a tilted sticker-style label and two calls to action: shop new and see offers. It sets the bright, playful tone whatever the store sells.
sections.layout: Full-bleed picture with the words and buttons overlaid bottom-left, a rotated badge in the corner

sections.label: Category tiles as a mosaic
sections.intent: Category tiles as a mosaic
sections.layout: a centered card floating over a tinted background

sections.label: A testimonial carousel with ratings
sections.intent: A testimonial carousel with ratings
sections.layout: a split with the picture bleeding off the edge

sections.label: Deal of the day with a countdown
sections.intent: Deal of the day with a countdown
sections.layout: centered narrow column with generous space

sections.label: A strip of promises
sections.intent: A strip of promises: delivery, returns, secure payment
sections.layout: centered narrow column with generous space

pages.label: Product listing
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Listing title band
sections.intent: Names the listing and shows how many products are in it, so shoppers know at a glance how much there is to browse.
sections.layout: A slim band under a thin rule, the title left and the count right

sections.label: Jump to a category
sections.intent: Rounded picture chips for the store's categories let shoppers narrow a big mixed catalogue in one tap before filtering.
sections.layout: Horizontal scroller of round chips with the next one peeking

sections.label: All products grid
sections.intent: Filters and sort beside an image-led grid. Cards carry quick add, wishlist, price and tilted discount labels so shoppers can buy without opening every product.
sections.layout: Filters in a column on the left, a three- or four-up card grid on the right

pages.label: Category pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Category welcome
sections.intent: Breadcrumbs, the name from <Category> as a big heading with its tagline and short description, over its hero picture. Subcategories from <SubCategories> sit below as rounded chips and hide when there are none.
sections.layout: A full-width band with the words over the picture bottom-left, chips in a row beneath

sections.label: Shop this category
sections.intent: The category's products in a picture-first grid with filters to narrow by size, brand, price or anything the category needs. Sort sits above.
sections.layout: Filters in a column on the left, the grid on the right under a slim sort row

sections.label: Good to know
sections.intent: The category's questions from <CategoryFaqs> and its longer copy from <SeoText>, quiet and easy to read. Each hides when empty.
sections.layout: A centred narrow column with generous space, questions in an accordion above the text

pages.label: Brand pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Meet the brand
sections.intent: Breadcrumbs, then the logo and name from <Brand> beside its tagline and short story, with its website and social links, so shoppers know who makes what they're buying.
sections.layout: Two columns: a large logo on a rounded tile at the left, the words at the right

sections.label: The brand's products
sections.intent: Everything the store carries from <Brand> in a clean grid. The result count and sort sit on a toolbar and filters open in a drawer, keeping the page image-led.
sections.layout: A toolbar row over a full-width four-up grid, filters in a slide-out drawer

sections.label: More about them
sections.intent: The longer story from <Brand> and its <SeoText> for shoppers who want to read on. Each hides when empty.
sections.layout: A slim band under a thin rule, text in a centred narrow column

pages.label: Search results
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: What you searched
sections.intent: The term and number of results from <SearchQuery>, with the search box right there to try again. It speaks warmly and briefly when nothing matches.
sections.layout: A slim band, the term large on the left, the search box on the right

sections.label: Matching products
sections.intent: Filters beside the matching products so shoppers can narrow broad searches across a mixed catalogue.
sections.layout: Filters in a column on the left, the grid on the right with sort above

pages.label: Product page
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Pictures and buy box
sections.intent: Big product pictures beside a sticky buy box with title, rating, price with a tilted discount label, options, quantity, add to cart, buy now and a pincode delivery check, so shoppers across India know when it arrives.
sections.layout: Gallery left with a thumbnail rail, sticky buy box right

sections.label: Details and specs
sections.intent: The description and specifications in tabs. This works for any product type, from a kurta's fabric to a phone's battery.
sections.layout: A centred narrow column with rounded tabs

sections.label: What buyers say
sections.intent: Customer reviews, with the overall rating large beside the review list for quick reassurance.
sections.layout: Asymmetric 5/7 grid: the rating summary left, reviews right

sections.label: You may also like
sections.intent: Related products to keep shoppers browsing.
sections.layout: A full-width band with a centred heading over a horizontal scroller with the next card peeking

pages.label: Cart
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Free delivery meter
sections.intent: Shows how close the cart is to free delivery, with a cheerful nudge.
sections.layout: A slim full-width band with a rounded progress bar

sections.label: Your bag
sections.intent: Cart lines beside the summary, coupon box and checkout button. A friendly empty state appears when nothing is in the cart.
sections.layout: Lines left, a sticky rounded summary card right

sections.label: Add before you go
sections.intent: Small add-ons that suit the cart, each one tap to add.
sections.layout: A horizontal scroller of cards with the next one peeking

pages.label: Checkout
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Checkout steps
sections.intent: Contact, address, delivery options and payment (UPI, cards, COD as the store offers) beside the order summary with a coupon box.
sections.layout: Form steps left, a sticky order summary right; summary first on phones

sections.label: Safe and sorted
sections.intent: Trust badges for secure payment, easy returns and help, to calm last-step nerves.
sections.layout: A quiet centred band with three columns and thin dividers

pages.label: About
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Hello, we are
sections.intent: The store's name or founding year set huge as the graphic, with one warm line about who the store is for.
sections.layout: An oversized word or number filling the width, a short line beneath it

sections.label: Our story
sections.intent: The story in a few short paragraphs beside a big picture of the team, shop or products.
sections.layout: A split with the picture bleeding off the right edge, words on the left

sections.label: Kind words
sections.intent: A handful of real customer reviews, so newcomers see the store is trusted.
sections.layout: Cards that overlap slightly, offset vertically, each with a tilted star label

sections.label: Start shopping
sections.intent: An inviting close that sends readers to the store's categories.
sections.layout: Full-bleed picture with the words and a button overlaid bottom-left

pages.label: Contact
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Reach us
sections.intent: Phone, email, WhatsApp and address, each with a bright icon and one tap to act.
sections.layout: Three equal columns with thin dividers

sections.label: Quick answers
sections.intent: Common questions on delivery, returns, COD and order tracking, so many shoppers never need to write in.
sections.layout: A centred narrow column with an accordion

sections.label: Say hi on WhatsApp
sections.intent: A cheerful band inviting a chat or call, with the store's hours.
sections.layout: A split with the picture bleeding off the left edge, the button on the right

pages.label: All categories
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Everything we sell
sections.intent: Every category from <AllCategories> as picture tiles under a big heading with breadcrumbs. Subcategories and product counts sit under each tile.
sections.layout: A centred heading over a mosaic with one large tile

sections.label: Browse it all
sections.intent: A closing nudge to see every product at once.
sections.layout: An edge-to-edge marquee strip with a button

pages.label: All brands
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Brands we carry
sections.intent: Featured brands from <AllBrands> shown large first, then every brand as a dense logo wall with taglines and counts, under a heading with breadcrumbs.
sections.layout: A centred heading over large featured tiles, then a logo wall

sections.label: Browse it all
sections.intent: An invitation to browse every product, for shoppers not set on a brand.
sections.layout: A slim band under a thin rule, line left, button right

pages.label: Footer
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Bottom of the page
sections.intent: The store's line set large with the logo, beside link columns for shop, help and company. Social links and a short newsletter sign-up sit in a slim bottom bar.
sections.layout: A large brand line beside the link columns, a slim bottom bar under it

pages.label: Sign in
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Centred sign-in
sections.intent: Centred sign-in: a short welcome line in the store voice over <SignInForm /> on a softly tinted band, the store name small under it
sections.layout: on a band in the brand colour with light text

sections.label: Reassurance strip
sections.intent: Reassurance strip: a secure sign-in with a one-time code, orders and returns in one place, saved addresses, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Sign up
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Join split
sections.intent: Join split: a brand panel with the reasons to create an account (every order in one place, saved addresses, a quicker checkout, a wishlist) beside <SignUpForm />
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: What an account gives
sections.intent: What an account gives: orders in one place, saved addresses, a wishlist, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface with generous space

pages.label: Account pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Account frame
sections.intent: Account frame: a slim welcome band in the store voice (never a name), then <AccountPage /> full width under it
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: Help band
sections.intent: Help band: where to get help with an order, returns and the policies, as a few quiet links (/support, /return-policy, /legal)
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Order details
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Order page
sections.intent: Order page: a slim band with a link back to all orders (/account/orders), then <OrderDetail /> full width
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: Help with this order
sections.intent: Help with this order: contact options from <Store> and links to returns (/return-policy) and support (/support)
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Wishlist
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Wishlist
sections.intent: Wishlist: a heading band in the store voice for saved favourites (the page’s h1), then <WishlistGrid /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: More to love
sections.intent: More to love: best sellers from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Compare
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Compare
sections.intent: Compare: a quiet title strip with the h1, then <CompareTable /> full width
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: Help choosing
sections.intent: Help choosing: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Policies
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Policies
sections.intent: Policies: <LegalContent /> full width on a calm surface under a thin rule
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Questions
sections.intent: Questions: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Returns
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Returns
sections.intent: Returns: a clear heading band (the page’s h1) with a short reassuring line that makes no promise, then <ReturnsContent /> full width
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: Still need help
sections.intent: Still need help: contact options from <Store> and a link to support (/support)
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Help and support
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Help centre
sections.intent: Help centre: a tinted band with the h1 and a short line, then <SupportContent /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Call or message
sections.intent: Call or message: a closing band inviting a call or a WhatsApp message through <Store>
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

pages.label: Page not found
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Lost page
sections.intent: Lost page: an oversized 404 in the store’s type and a friendly line in the store voice (the h1), with <NotFoundContent /> under it
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: New in
sections.intent: New in: the newest products from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: centred, with generous space
